items.title: AMD’s best gaming CPU drops below launch price and includes free 240mm AIO cooler and Onimusha: Way of the Sword — grab the Ryzen 7 9850X3D for $484
items.description: The Ryzen 7 9850X3D may only be a modest step up from the 9800X3D, but it still leads our gaming benchmarks and now comes with a couple of useful extras at a lower-than-launch price.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 1 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter For those seeking the highest performance for gaming, AMD’s Ryzen 7 9850X3D is currently the best CPU money can buy. If you’re planning to upgrade or build a new PC, now might be a good time to pick one up, as Newegg is selling the 9850X3D for $484, around $15 less than its launch price. The deal also includes a 240mm Cooler Master AIO liquid cooler, valued at $79.99, along with a copy of Onimusha: Way of the Sword worth $69.99, both included as free gifts. Check out the deal on Newegg Announced at CES 2026, the Ryzen 7 9850X3D is essentially a higher-binned version of the Ryzen 7 9800X3D. It retains the same 8-core, 16-thread configuration and 4.2 GHz base clock as its predecessor, but gets a higher 5.6 GHz boost clock. The chip comes with the same 104MB of total cache, including 96MB of 3D V-Cache, which is the key ingredient behind its strong gaming performance. It also shares the same 120W default TDP and uses the AM5 platform with DDR5 memory support, making it compatible with a wide range of existing 800- and 600-series AMD motherboards. Save $15AMD Ryzen 7 9850X3D: was $499 now $484 at NeweggBuilt on AMD’s Zen 5 architecture, the Ryzen 7 9850X3D combines 8 cores and 16 threads with a 5.6GHz boost clock and 96MB of 3D V-Cache.View Deal In our in-depth testing of the Ryzen 7 9850X3D, we found that it was only 3.3% faster than the Ryzen 7 9800X3D. But a win is a win, and that performance edge puts the CPU at the top of our 16-game 1080p FPS performance geomean, beating the more expensive Ryzen 9 9900X3D and 9950X3D. Although it loses out to Intel in some productivity workloads, the less complex 8-core configuration packed into a single CCD results in lower power draw. As you can see from our results, the peak power consumption is around 170W, making it much easier to cool. At its sale price of $484, you’re paying less than its actual launch price while getting two useful extras at no additional cost. That makes this a worthwhile deal for anyone looking to build a high-end gaming PC around AMD’s gaming-focused platform.

items.titleZh: AMD’s best gaming CPU drops below launch price and includes free 240mm AIO cooler and Onimusha: Way of the Sword — grab the Ryzen 7 9850X3D for $484
items.descriptionZh:
AMD 近日为新蛋（Newegg）上的 Ryzen 7 9850X3D 推出促销：售价 484 美元，比 499 美元首发价低约 15 美元，并附赠价值 79.99 美元的酷冷至尊 240mm 一体式水冷，以及价值 69.99 美元的《鬼武者：Way of the Sword》游戏。该处理器于 CES 2026 发布，定位为当前最强游戏 CPU，本质上是 Ryzen 7 9800X3D 的更高体质版本。

核心规格方面，Ryzen 7 9850X3D 基于 AMD Zen 5 架构，维持 8 核 16 线程和 4.2 GHz 基础频率，但加速频率提升至 5.6 GHz。缓存总量仍为 104MB，其中 96MB 为 3D V-Cache。3D V-Cache 通过堆叠大容量 L3 缓存，显著降低游戏中的内存访问延迟，是其游戏性能领先的关键。默认 TDP 为 120W，但实测峰值功耗约 170W。平台方面，它沿用 AM5 接口，支持 DDR5 内存，并兼容现有 600 系和 800 系 AMD 主板。

性能测试显示，Ryzen 7 9850X3D 仅比 9800X3D 快约 3.3%，但在 16 款游戏的 1080p FPS 几何平均测试中排名第一，超过价格更高的 Ryzen 9 9900X3D 和 9950X3D。虽然在部分生产力负载中不敌 Intel，但其单 CCD、8 核结构带来更低功耗和更好散热表现。搭配赠送的 240mm AIO 水冷，游戏和中等负载下温度可控，重度多核负载下可能偏热。

总体来看，这次促销价低于首发价，还附带实用水冷和游戏，适合计划组装或升级高端游戏 PC 的玩家。AM5 平台兼容性广，加上 3D V-Cache 带来的高帧率优势，使其对追求 1080p 高刷新率游戏体验的用户尤其有吸引力。

items.title: Bernie Sanders proposes 20 year prison sentence for AI devs who plow ahead with Artificial Superintelligence plans — penalty on par with illegally developing rogue nuclear weapons
items.description: Senators Bernie Sanders and Greg Cezar have announced their Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act which threatens 20-year prison sentences for rule breakers.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 14 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Senators Bernie Sanders and Greg Cezar have announced their Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act. Seeking to pause advanced AI development, the legislation’s stick is pretty severe. Penalties facing entities/developers who violate the pauses and prohibitions in the bill could face up to 20 years in prison. That’s a sentence on a par with someone found guilty of designing a rogue nuclear weapon. (Image credit: Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act)The news is suddenly filled with grave concerns about AI becoming too powerful. It could even threaten the future of humanity. Moreover, it might surprise casual observers that AI industry leaders like Sam Altman, Dario Amodei, and Elon Musk appear to agree. With this threat on the horizon, politicians are keen to introduce legislation to protect the citizens they serve.According to USA Today, the Sanders bill “is the most extreme AI-related legislation to date.” It likely faces strong opposition in Congress, particularly among enterprise-supporting Democrats and Trump-aligned Republicans. However, with recent statements from industry leaders seemingly harmonizing with calls to slow down AI development and in favor of greater oversight/regulation, we could see politicians agree on something for a change.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Back to the Ban Artificial Superintelligence and Temporarily Pause Advanced AI Development bill and its specific wording, we note that it is advised that the government set up a new cabinet-level federal agency "to safeguard the public from the dangers of artificial intelligence, including by enforcing a prohibition on artificial superintelligence." As well as setting harsh penalties in the U.S., it is proposed that work be done to "ban superintelligence around the world" via international agreements, allied coordination, and so on.Full speed ahead, or hit the brakes?There remain plenty of interesting arguments on both sides of the AI progress divide. It is difficult to argue that the U.S. shouldn’t keep going as fast as it can, as a matter of national security, for example. On the other hand, the whole of humanity being wiped from the face of the Earth by opening Pandora’s AI box of tricks makes geopolitical concerns seem like minor grumbles. Some critics say they may be running out of road, unable to balance private investments with credible paths to profitability. Thus, they now want to move away from a commercially funded model to a government-funded ‘Manhattan Project II,’ with their terrifyingly powerful AI being guarded by the state. items.titleZh: Bernie Sanders proposes 20 year prison sentence for AI devs who plow ahead with Artificial Superintelligence plans — penalty on par with illegally developing rogue nuclear weapons
items.descriptionZh:
美国参议员伯尼·桑德斯与格雷格·塞扎尔宣布提出《禁止人工超级智能法案》（Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act），其完整目标还包括“暂时暂停高级人工智能发展”。该法案试图暂停先进 AI 开发，并设置了极为严厉的惩罚：违反法案中暂停与禁止条款的实体或开发者，最高可面临 20 年监禁。这一刑期被类比为与设计失控核武器同级。据 USA Today 报道，这是迄今为止“最极端的 AI 相关立法”。法案预计将在国会遭遇强烈反对，尤其是来自支持企业界的民主党人和与特朗普阵营一致的共和党人；但近期 AI 行业领袖的表态似乎与“放缓 AI 发展、加强监管”的呼吁趋同，因此也可能出现政界罕见达成共识的情况。

法案的具体机制包括：建议政府设立一个新的内阁级联邦机构，负责“保护公众免受人工智能危险”，包括执行对人工超级智能的禁令。除在美国国内实施严厉处罚外，法案还提议通过国际协议、盟友协调等方式，推动“在全球范围内禁止超级智能”。这里所谓“人工超级智能”，通常指在几乎所有认知任务上远超人类水平的人工智能系统。因此，该法案并非针对现有窄域 AI 或普通大模型，而是试图从法律和制度层面阻止超级智能的出现。原文没有披露具体模型架构、训练方法、算力规模或性能基准数据；其“对比数据”主要体现在法律处罚力度上：20 年监禁与设计 rogue nuclear weapon 相当。该法案的创新点也不在技术突破，而在政策工具组合：刑事重罚、内阁级监管机构、国际协调与全球禁令。

新闻背景是近期关于 AI 变得过于强大、甚至威胁人类未来的担忧骤然升温。令人注意的是，Sam Altman、Dario Amodei、Elon Musk 等 AI 行业领袖似乎也认同这类风险。争论的核心是“全速前进还是踩刹车”：一方认为，从国家安全角度，美国不可能也不应放慢 AI 发展；另一方则认为，如果打开 AI 潘多拉魔盒导致人类被从地球上抹去，那么地缘政治担忧都只是小问题。相关立法动向还包括：桑德斯另提法案建议美国 AI 公司 50% 公有制并向公众发放 1,000 美元股息；两党法案提议为最强 AI 模型设置“kill switches”；Anthropic CEO 警告 AI 驱动的 botnet“swarm”可能接管整个互联网。对于 AI 巨头突然支持监管，批评者提出另一种解释：它们可能已快走到商业模式的尽头，难以平衡私人投资与可信盈利路径，因此希望从商业资助模式转向政府资助的“曼哈顿计划 II”，由国家对强大 AI 进行守护。

若该法案推进，将深刻影响美国 AI 研发合规、投资策略、开源与闭源路线、全球竞争和地缘政治。其应用场景主要包括联邦监管执法、AI 公司合规审查、国际协议谈判、盟友协调以及国家安全风险管控。不过，鉴于国会阻力，该法案通过前景很低。总体而言，这则新闻反映 AI 安全辩论已从技术伦理讨论进入刑事立法和全球禁令的极端政策层面。

items.title: Intel revives One Mono font after brief retirement during open-source purge — typeface built to fight coder eyestrain gets reprieve
items.description: Intel’s decision to archive its developer-focused One Mono font lasted only two days, with the company now restoring the open-source project despite its relatively limited development activity.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Intel has reversed its decision to shelve its open-source font project designed specifically with developers in mind. The font’s GitHub repository was archived earlier this week, only for the company to reportedly restore the project and potentially continue to maintain it. The cancellation came amid a wider reduction in Intel’s open-source efforts. According to Phoronix, Intel has been closing down projects where development has slowed, or the employees responsible for them have exited the company.Introduced back in 2023, One Mono is a monospace font where each character occupies the same horizontal width. Intel carried out the development in collaboration with type design studio Frere-Jones Type and marketing agency VMLY&R. Working with low-vision and legally blind developers during the design process, live testing sessions were conducted to identify characters that could be difficult to distinguish when reading code.“Identifying the typographically underserved low-vision developer audience, we designed the Intel One Mono typeface for maximum legibility to address developers' fatigue and eyestrain and reduce coding errors,” said Intel in its introduction.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: The font was designed with several features to improve legibility, including distinctions between similar-looking letters and coding characters. For example, characters such as the lowercase “e” and uppercase “G” were given more distinctive shapes to make them easier to identify. The difference in height between uppercase and lowercase letters was also increased, along with longer ascenders and descenders to make blocks of code easier to read. Additionally, the font supports more than 200 languages using the Latin script and is available in Light, Regular, Medium, and Bold weights, along with matching italics.As mentioned, One Mono is available under an open-source license; thus, developers are free to use and modify it. Unfortunately, the font has not witnessed any significant updates since 2024, with activity during 2025 reportedly limited to Readme updates. Thus, its archival seemed pretty obvious, especially with Intel shutting down projects that were no longer seeing active development. For now, the font has managed to avoid becoming a casualty of Intel’s open-source cleanup. While the project remains silent, its revival means the developer-focused font is not being abandoned after all. items.titleZh: 英特尔在开源清理中短暂退役后重启One Mono字体——这款为对抗程序员眼疲劳而打造的字体获得缓刑
items.descriptionZh:
Intel 近日逆转了此前搁置其专为开发者设计的开源字体项目 One Mono 的决定。该字体的 GitHub 仓库曾于本周早些时候被归档，但随后公司据报恢复了项目，并可能继续维护。这一反复发生在 Intel 更广泛收缩开源投入的背景下。据 Phoronix 报道，Intel 正在关闭那些开发进度放缓、或负责员工已经离职的项目，因此 One Mono 最初被归档并不令人意外。

One Mono 于 2023 年推出，是一款等宽字体，即每个字符占据相同的水平宽度，这使其特别适合代码编辑器和终端等编程场景。Intel 与字体设计工作室 Frere-Jones Type 以及营销机构 VMLY&R 合作开发了这款字体。设计过程中，团队与低视力及法定盲人开发者合作，并通过现场测试来识别阅读代码时容易混淆的字符。Intel 在介绍中表示：“我们识别出排版领域服务不足的低视力开发者群体，设计了 Intel One Mono 字体，以最大化可读性，缓解开发者的疲劳和眼疲劳，并减少编码错误。”

在技术细节上，One Mono 针对可读性做了多项优化。例如，小写“e”和大写“G”等字符被赋予更独特的形状，以便更容易区分；大写和小写字母之间的高度差被加大，同时上升部和下降部也被延长，从而使整块代码更易于阅读。该字体支持 200 多种使用拉丁字母的语言，并提供 Light、Regular、Medium、Bold 四种字重以及匹配的斜体。作为开源字体，开发者可以自由使用和修改它。

从应用场景看，One Mono 主要面向需要长时间阅读和编写代码的开发者，尤其是低视力用户。它试图在等宽字体这一细分领域中，通过包容性设计提升编程体验，减少因字符混淆而导致的错误。不过，该字体自 2024 年以来没有重大更新，2025 年的活动据报仅限于 Readme 更新，因此其归档曾显得顺理成章。目前，One Mono 已避免成为 Intel 开源清理的牺牲品。尽管项目仍保持沉默，但此次复活意味着这款面向开发者的字体并未被彻底放弃。其未来维护频率和更新计划仍有待观察，但至少短期内它不会从开源社区消失。

items.title: Chinese military researchers and tech giants caught using Claude — US frontier model coded 16 air-defense suppression tools targeting Taiwan, drafted anti-torpedo specs, and fed 151 million training queries to Alibaba
items.description: Anthropic accuses China-linked actors of using its Claude models of weapon development, intelligence activities, distilling AI models.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter While China claims to have advanced AI models that may well compete against those developed in the U.S., for some reason, hundreds of China-linked agents allegedly used Anthropic for at least five different programs: two military, two surveillance, and one aimed at distilling Claude's capabilities, according to Anthropic's September 2026 threat report.Two military programsOne China-based actor used Claude to draft a fire-control specification for an anti-torpedo fire-control system (the core logic that determines when and where an anti-torpedo weapon should engage an incoming threat), test the potential system against U.S. Navy anti-torpedo and anti-submarine systems based on public knowledge about these programs, and prep a 200+ page technical proposal for a potential client. While the actor disguised itself as an OEM in the U.S. defense sector, Anthropic believes that the actor was associated with a Chinese defense manufacturer seeking to develop a system for the People's Liberation Army Navy.Another China-based defense and military-industrial researcher used Claude to develop about 16 software modules for electronic warfare and suppression of enemy air defenses. The software analyzed radars, SAM sites, command posts, and communications nodes and prioritized targets. At one point, the default scenario contained 12 targets in Taiwan, including Patriot and Tien Kung batteries, air bases, an early-warning radar, and a command bunker. Interestingly, Anthropic claims that account metadata and content caught by its safeguards 'indicated the actor was linked to PRC research institutions, including the PLA Academy of Military Sciences,' though it does not outright say that Claude was used by the PLA.Given China's considerable AI capabilities — which may still lag behind those of the United States in some areas (more on this later) — it is striking that two Chinese military-related projects relied on Anthropic's Claude. Given the Chinese-language prompts and other account-level evidence identified by Anthropic, plausible deniability hardly seems to have been the primary reason for choosing Claude over domestic alternatives. More likely, Claude was simply better or more convenient for these particular engineering workflows, particularly coding, reasoning, and agentic tasks. There may also have been another advantage: U.S. frontier models are trained on enormous amounts of English-language material and could therefore have particularly extensive knowledge of publicly available information about American military technologies and systems.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Given China's major AI prowess (which may well fall short of American, but still be quite capable), it is interesting to see two Chinese military projects using Anthropic AI. Given Chinese IP addresses and Chinese language prompts detected by Anthropic, plausible deniability is certainly not the main reason for using Claude instead of using domestic tools (more on this later). Apparently, Claude was better or more convenient for these particular engineering workflows (coding => reasoning => agentic) than whatever models the actors could readily access. Furthermore, after all, U.S. frontier models were trained mostly on English-language materials, and they may have way more information about American military capability than Chinese spy channels have ever gotten (we are speculating, of course).Significant surveillance activitiesAnthropic also disrupted China-linked surveillance operations related to Uyghurs outside of China, perhaps because similar operations are already in place in the Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region. One China government-linked actor used Claude to infiltrate Uyghur armed groups in Syria and surveil Uyghur diaspora activists and media, while posing as an Arabic-speaking 'expert' consultant. You may like Anthropic claims that China's Alibaba illicitly 'distilled' its models from April to June 2026 Alibaba bans Anthropic's Claude Code after an alleged hidden China-detection backdoor is uncovered China alleges that Claude Code contains backdoors, calls mechanism 'a serious threat' Once the agent had infiltrated the said groups, Claude helped process information collected from more than a hundred WhatsApp groups and dozens of Telegram channels, identify people across platforms, map social networks, and reveal potential recruitment targets considered vulnerable because of financial problems, family separation, or ideological disillusionment with the new Syrian government.The actor also singled out individuals with relatives remaining in Xinjiang, while Claude helped draft deceptive approaches in local dialects, locate people and organizations, translate conversations in real time, and evaluate the credibility of recruitment messages. The same operation targeted diaspora journalists, particularly Uyghur Post, with coordinated mass-reporting and bot-amplification campaigns.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsStealing from AnthropicPerhaps the most ironic thing about Anthropic's findings is that Chinese entities steal from the company. While reported broadly in 2024 – 2025, it does not stop Chinese entities from using distillation, the main way to 'steal' an AI model's capabilities without obtaining the model itself.Anthropic says several major Chinese AI developers conducted industrial-scale distillation campaigns designed to extract Claude's reasoning and other capabilities and reproduce them in their own models. The largest one allegedly came from Alibaba, whose operators generated more than 151 million Claude exchanges between May and July 2026. At one point, this approached 3 million requests per day through thousands of fraudulent accounts. Anthropic says the harvested chain-of-thought data helped train Qwen 3.x, particularly for reasoning, coding, agentic software engineering, kernel development, and long-horizon tasks, according to Anthropic.Alibaba is far from alone, as Anthropic accuses DeepSeek, Xiaomi, Zhipu/Z.ai, and others of similar campaigns. Techniques they have allegedly used span from proxy networks and fraudulent accounts to disguising the secret entity all the way to forwarding their own customers' requests to Claude and purchasing harvested Claude conversations from third parties. DeepSeek alone allegedly generated more than 12.1 million exchanges in 14 days, while Xiaomi generated more than 400,000.Anthropic defines this activity as distillation: covertly extracting a frontier model's answers and then replicating the knowledge at a fraction of the compute, time, and cost required to develop them in-house. items.titleZh: 中国军事研究人员和科技巨头被抓使用Claude——美国前沿模型编写了16种针对台湾的防空压制工具，起草了反鱼雷规格，并向阿里巴巴提供了1.51亿次训练查询
items.descriptionZh:
Anthropic 2026年9月威胁报告披露，尽管中国宣称已拥有可与美国竞争的前沿AI模型，但据称有数百个与中国有关联的行为体使用Anthropic的Claude，至少涉及五类项目：两个军事项目、两个监控项目，以及一个旨在蒸馏Claude能力的项目。报告的核心含义是，美国前沿模型在部分工程、情报和模型训练场景中，仍被中国相关行为体视为高价值工具；即便存在中国本土替代品，Claude在编码、推理和智能体任务上可能更好用或更便捷。

两个军事项目尤其引人关注。第一个项目中，一个中国行为体使用Claude起草反鱼雷火控系统规格。火控系统的核心逻辑决定反鱼雷武器应在何时、何地拦截来袭威胁。该行为体还基于公开知识，用Claude测试潜在系统对抗美国海军反鱼雷和反潜系统的能力，并准备了一份200多页的技术建议书，面向潜在客户。该行为体伪装成美国国防部门原始设备制造商，但Anthropic认为其实际与中国一家国防制造商有关，目标是为中国人民解放军海军开发系统。第二个项目中，一名中国国防与军工研究员使用Claude开发了约16个电子战和压制敌方防空（SEAD）软件模块。这些软件用于分析雷达、地空导弹阵地、指挥所和通信节点，并对目标进行优先级排序。报告称，其默认场景包含台湾的12个目标，包括爱国者与天弓防空导弹阵地、空军基地、预警雷达和指挥掩体。Anthropic表示，账户元数据和内容显示该行为体与中华人民共和国研究机构有关，包括解放军军事科学院，但并未直接断言Claude被解放军使用。

报告特别指出，考虑到中国自身AI能力并不弱，两个与中国军方相关的项目依赖Claude，说明“合理推诿”并非选择Claude的主要原因。更可能的解释是，Claude在这些特定工程流程中表现更好或更便于使用，尤其是编码、推理和智能体任务。另一个潜在优势是，美国前沿模型主要用海量英文材料训练，可能对公开可得的美国军事技术和系统信息掌握更广。换言之，Claude不仅可能在某些能力上领先，还可能因英文语料优势而更了解美国军事体系。

监控活动方面，Anthropic还中断了与中国有关联、针对境外维吾尔人的监控行动。报告推测，这可能与新疆地区已有类似行动有关。一个与中国政府有关联的行为体冒充阿拉伯语“专家”顾问，使用Claude渗透叙利亚的维吾尔武装团体，并监控维吾尔侨民活动人士和媒体。渗透后，Claude帮助处理来自100多个WhatsApp群组和数十个Telegram频道的信息，跨平台识别人员、绘制社交网络，并找出潜在招募目标。报告称，这些目标被认为因经济困难、家庭分离或对新叙利亚政府意识形态幻灭而较为脆弱。该行为体还专门挑出有亲属留在新疆的人，并利用Claude起草当地方言的欺骗性接触话术、定位人员和组织、实时翻译对话，以及评估招募信息的可信度。同一行动还针对侨民记者，尤其是《维吾尔邮报》，通过协调大规模举报和机器人放大运动进行攻击。

最具讽刺意味的部分是模型蒸馏。Anthropic称，多家中国主要AI开发商进行了工业规模的蒸馏活动，试图提取Claude的推理等能力并复制到自家模型中。其中最大规模据称来自阿里巴巴：2026年5月至7月，其操作者生成了超过1.51亿次Claude交互，某时每天接近300万次请求，并通过数千个欺诈账户实施。Anthropic称，收集到的思维链数据帮助训练了Qwen 3.x，尤其在推理、编码、智能体软件工程、内核开发和长时程任务方面。阿里巴巴并非个例，Anthropic还指控DeepSeek、小米、智谱/Z.ai等存在类似活动。其所谓手段包括代理网络、欺诈账户、伪装秘密实体、把自家客户请求转发给Claude，以及从第三方购买已收集的Claude对话。DeepSeek据称在14天内生成超过1210万次交互，小米则超过40万次。Anthropic将蒸馏定义为：秘密提取前沿模型的答案，然后以远低于内部开发的算力、时间和成本复制相关知识。

总体来看，这份报告描绘了前沿AI模型被滥用于军事工程、电子战、跨境监控、社会网络情报和模型能力窃取的完整链条。其技术影响在于，AI模型可显著降低复杂军事软件、目标分析和情报处理的门槛；同时，模型蒸馏使开发商能在不获取权重的情况下，以大量API交互和思维链数据快速逼近前沿能力。对Anthropic等前沿模型厂商而言，这意味着滥用检测、账户安全、代理网络识别和蒸馏防御将成为持续挑战；对政策层面而言，则涉及AI出口管制、模型安全、地缘政治竞争以及开源与闭源模型生态的治理问题。

items.title: Mexican cartel's crypto farm seized in mountain raid — 300 GPUs, satellite links, and industrial transformers tapped hydroelectric power
items.description: There is increasing evidence that Mexican drug cartels are diversifying into cryptocurrency mining and are using crypto platforms to launder their ill-gotten gains.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 2 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter There is increasing evidence that Mexican drug cartels are diversifying into cryptocurrency mining and are using crypto platforms to diversify their income and, at the same time, launder their ill-gotten gains and fund other illegal activities. Reuters reports that local Mexican police uncovered a clandestine cryptocurrency farm in Tlaola, a town located in the leafy mountains of Puebla's Sierra Norte region. They found 300 GPUs, electricity infrastructure, and satellite equipment. The electricity-hungry operation likely drew power by secretly tapping into the grid at Presa de Necaxa, a nearby hydroelectric dam.Go deeper with TH Premium: AI shortages (Image credit: Nvidia)AI data centers are swallowing the world's memory and storage supplyDemand for data center CPUs has surged, and AI agents are responsibleChip scarcity assaults auto industry amid the worsening Nexperia and DRAM crisisThe custom AI ASIC state of playWhile this latest hidden facility found by police may seem small, Reuters notes it is the fourth such crypto farm Mexican authorities have uncovered in this region since early last year. According to a Mexico-based security analyst, the crypto farms discovered show that the cartels are increasingly sophisticated in their operations. In the latest bust, the Mexican federal authorities, the Navy, and state police seized around 300 GPUs, 80 medium-voltage terminations, a transformer, and eight satellite antennas.It might not be surprising to hear about the Mexican cartels being tied up in crypto. Blockchain analytics firm Chainalysis, as cited by Reuters, reckons illicit crypto transactions grew from $59 billion in 2024 to $154 billion last year. The firm links the surge recorded to sanctions evasion involving governments. However, in South America, cartels are increasingly interested in using this channel to launder money. The mining operations are also integrated into the scheme, as stealing electricity is easy for organized crime. Mainstream consumer GPU mining ended in H2 2022, flooding the market with used graphics cards.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: The source report doesn’t say how authorities found the crypto farm. Perhaps locals in this remote area of Puebla alerted authorities to the operation. Two folks from neighboring communities told Reuters that they could hear the crypto farm noise (transformers, cooling) from a kilometer away (0.6 miles), and the place was apparently a mere 2 km (1.2 miles) from the nearest village. The other three recently uncovered crypto farms were also near the same HEP dam, it is noted. Tlaola is a small community with around 20,000 inhabitants, so the noise levels and power consumption of crypto farms are very perceptible even if the cartels try to hide them deep in the mountains.Remote communities, such as Tlaola, are popular locations for clandestine crypto farms because the electricity is cheap and most of them are under the protection of the cartels. For example, the Cartel Jalisco Nueva Generación (CJNG) and its armed branch, La Barredora, have the strongest presence in Puebla. Drug cartels such as the Cartel de Sinaloa and the CJNG have set up crypto farms to mine Bitcoin (BTC), Monero (XMR), and Tether (USDT).Similarly remote, illicit cryptomining facilities exist around the world, with Reuters recalling news of raids in Brazil, the U.S., and Thailand. items.titleZh: Mexican cartel's crypto farm seized in mountain raid — 300 GPUs, satellite links, and industrial transformers tapped hydroelectric power
items.descriptionZh:
路透社报道称，墨西哥贩毒集团正越来越多地涉足加密货币挖矿，并利用加密平台实现收入多元化、洗钱以及资助其他非法活动。墨西哥警方在普埃布拉州北部山区小镇特拉奥拉发现了一座秘密加密货币矿场，现场有约300块GPU、电力基础设施和卫星设备。该矿场耗电巨大，很可能通过秘密接入附近普雷萨德内卡哈水电站的电网来偷电。这已是墨西哥当局自去年初以来在同一地区发现的第四座此类加密货币矿场，显示出贩毒集团相关操作的复杂程度正在上升。

在最新一次突袭中，墨西哥联邦当局、海军和州警察缴获了约300块GPU、80个中压终端设备、一台变压器和八根卫星天线。从技术原理看，加密货币挖矿依赖大量GPU并行执行哈希运算，以争夺区块链记账权并获得代币奖励。这种过程耗电量极高、发热量大、噪音明显，还需要持续的网络连接和冷却系统。卫星天线可能用于在偏远山区建立网络连接或规避地面通信监控，而偷电则显著降低了矿场的运营成本。犯罪组织正是利用偏远地区电价低廉、执法薄弱且受卡特尔势力保护的条件，把非法电力转化为可交易的加密资产。

目前尚不清楚当局是如何发现这座矿场的。路透社称，附近社区居民表示，他们能在约1公里外听到矿场变压器和冷却设备产生的噪音，而该矿场距离最近的村庄仅约2公里。特拉奥拉约有2万居民，因此矿场的噪音和电力消耗即便被藏匿在深山中也很难完全不被察觉。此前发现的三座矿场也位于同一座水电站附近。这类偏远社区之所以成为秘密矿场热门地点，是因为电力便宜，且许多地区处于贩毒集团控制之下。例如，哈利斯科新一代卡特尔及其武装分支“拉巴雷多拉”在普埃布拉势力最强。

加密货币与墨西哥贩毒集团的关联并不令人意外。区块链分析公司Chainalysis的数据显示，非法加密货币交易规模从2024年的590亿美元增至上年的1540亿美元，这一激增与政府制裁规避行为有关；而在南美，卡特尔越来越倾向于利用加密渠道洗钱。墨西哥网络安全公司SILIKN指出，去年墨西哥利用加密货币挖矿洗钱的活动至少增长了55.8%。锡那罗亚卡特尔和哈利斯科新一代卡特尔等组织已建立矿场，用于挖掘比特币、门罗币和泰达币。值得注意的是，主流消费者GPU挖矿已在2022年下半年结束，导致大量二手显卡涌入市场。

类似偏远地区的非法加密货币挖矿设施并非墨西哥独有。路透社提到，巴西、美国和泰国也曾有相关突袭行动。分析人士预计，未来几年与加密货币相关的犯罪可能达到新高度。此类案件的技术影响在于，它把能源盗窃、加密资产、洗钱和有组织犯罪结合在一起：一方面给偏远地区电网和社区生活带来负担，另一方面也增加了金融取证难度。虽然区块链分析工具可以追踪部分非法交易，但门罗币等隐私币、稳定币以及场外交易渠道仍会加大执法挑战，需要能源、网络和金融监管部门协同应对。

items.title: Build a high-end AMD gaming PC for less — Ryzen 7 9800X3D bundle includes an X870E motherboard, 32GB DDR5, AIO cooler and a game for $1,109.99
items.description: The bundle pairs one of the best gaming CPUs available with a premium X870E motherboard and 32GB of DDR5-6000 memory, while also throwing in a 240mm AIO cooler and a free copy of Onimusha: Way of the Sword.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter With the ongoing memory crisis driving up the price of RAM and other components, it is arguably one of the worst times to build a new gaming PC. However, bundle deals can be a good way to offset some of those inflated prices. Speaking of which, we’ve spotted an incredible AMD bundle over at Newegg that includes the AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D, an Asus TUF X870E motherboard, and 32GB of Corsair Vengeance RGB DDR5-6000 RAM for $1,109.99, offering savings of around $150. The bundle also includes a 240mm Cooler Master AIO liquid cooler and a copy of Onimusha: Way of the Sword as free gifts. Check out the deal in Newegg The Ryzen 7 9800X3D is an 8-core, 16-thread processor based on AMD’s Zen 5 architecture. With a 4.7 GHz base clock and up to 5.2 GHz boost clock, the highlight feature of the chip is its 3D V-Cache technology that helps in lowering latency and giving a boost in overall gaming performance. If you’re looking for the best gaming CPU for a high-end build, the Ryzen 7 9800X3D should be at the top of your list. It also offers enlarged heatsinks for the VRM, M.2 storage and PCH, as well as tools to overclock and fine tune various features.Last but not least, the bundle includes a Corsair Vengeance RGB kit with two 16GB DDR5 modules running at 6000 MT/s, with a CAS latency of CL36 and timings of 44-44-96. The memory features black aluminum heat spreaders with a patterned finish, along with RGB lighting across the top of each module. It also supports both Intel XMP and AMD EXPO profiles, making it easy to apply pre-configured memory overclocking settings.If we look at individual pricing, Ryzen 7 9800X3D is currently $469, while the Corsair RAM kit and Asus motherboard are listed at $499.99 and $289.99, respectively. You also get a CPU liquid cooler worth $79.99 and a copy of Onimusha: Way of the Sword worth $69.99. That puts the combined value at around $1,408.96, making the $1,109.99 bundle price a saving of nearly $300. If you're planning a high-end AMD gaming PC, this bundle is definitely worth exploring.

items.descriptionZh:
当前内存危机持续推高RAM等核心部件价格，DIY游戏PC的装机成本明显上升。在此背景下，Newegg推出的一款AMD平台捆绑套装成为对冲涨价的选项。该套装售价1109.99美元，包含AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D处理器、华硕TUF Gaming X870E-Plus WiFi7 ATX主板、32GB Corsair Vengeance RGB DDR5-6000内存，并附赠240mm Cooler Master AIO液冷散热器和《Onimusha: Way of the Sword》游戏。若按单独售价计算，CPU约469美元、内存约499.99美元、主板约289.99美元，加上散热器和游戏分别价值约79.99美元和69.99美元，合计约1408.96美元，因此套装可节省近300美元；若仅按Newegg标注的套装原价1258.98美元对比，则节省约150美元。

核心技术方面，Ryzen 7 9800X3D基于Zen 5架构，为8核16线程，基础频率4.7GHz，加速频率最高5.2GHz。其最大特色是3D V-Cache技术，通过在处理器上堆叠额外L3缓存，显著增加可用缓存容量，降低游戏等负载的内存访问延迟，从而提升帧率和游戏响应。该处理器被认为是高端游戏主机的首选CPU之一。华硕TUF Gaming X870E-Plus主板提供16+2+1相80A供电、DDR5内存支持、PCIe 5.0、四个M.2插槽，支持Wi-Fi 7、2.5Gb以太网、双USB4 40Gbps Type-C以及前置USB 20Gbps Type-C 30W PD快充，并配有加大VRM、M.2和PCH散热片，便于超频和精细调校。内存为两条16GB DDR5-6000，CL36，时序44-44-96，带黑色铝制散热片和RGB灯效，支持Intel XMP与AMD EXPO一键超频。

总体来看，该套装把当前价格较高的内存、主板和热门游戏CPU打包，适合计划组建高端AMD游戏PC的用户。X870E平台提供PCIe 5.0存储、USB4和Wi-Fi 7等扩展能力，能在未来一段时间内保持较好兼容性；而3D V-Cache则直接利好游戏性能。在内存价格高企时，这类捆绑可降低整机采购总成本，是需要升级或新装高端游戏平台时值得关注的方案。

history.title: AMD’s best gaming CPU drops below launch price and includes free 240mm AIO cooler and Onimusha: Way of the Sword — grab the Ryzen 7 9850X3D for $484
history.description: The Ryzen 7 9850X3D may only be a modest step up from the 9800X3D, but it still leads our gaming benchmarks and now comes with a couple of useful extras at a lower-than-launch price.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 1 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter For those seeking the highest performance for gaming, AMD’s Ryzen 7 9850X3D is currently the best CPU money can buy. If you’re planning to upgrade or build a new PC, now might be a good time to pick one up, as Newegg is selling the 9850X3D for $484, around $15 less than its launch price. The deal also includes a 240mm Cooler Master AIO liquid cooler, valued at $79.99, along with a copy of Onimusha: Way of the Sword worth $69.99, both included as free gifts. Check out the deal on Newegg Announced at CES 2026, the Ryzen 7 9850X3D is essentially a higher-binned version of the Ryzen 7 9800X3D. It retains the same 8-core, 16-thread configuration and 4.2 GHz base clock as its predecessor, but gets a higher 5.6 GHz boost clock. The chip comes with the same 104MB of total cache, including 96MB of 3D V-Cache, which is the key ingredient behind its strong gaming performance. It also shares the same 120W default TDP and uses the AM5 platform with DDR5 memory support, making it compatible with a wide range of existing 800- and 600-series AMD motherboards. Save $15AMD Ryzen 7 9850X3D: was $499 now $484 at NeweggBuilt on AMD’s Zen 5 architecture, the Ryzen 7 9850X3D combines 8 cores and 16 threads with a 5.6GHz boost clock and 96MB of 3D V-Cache.View Deal In our in-depth testing of the Ryzen 7 9850X3D, we found that it was only 3.3% faster than the Ryzen 7 9800X3D. But a win is a win, and that performance edge puts the CPU at the top of our 16-game 1080p FPS performance geomean, beating the more expensive Ryzen 9 9900X3D and 9950X3D. Although it loses out to Intel in some productivity workloads, the less complex 8-core configuration packed into a single CCD results in lower power draw. As you can see from our results, the peak power consumption is around 170W, making it much easier to cool. At its sale price of $484, you’re paying less than its actual launch price while getting two useful extras at no additional cost. That makes this a worthwhile deal for anyone looking to build a high-end gaming PC around AMD’s gaming-focused platform.

核心规格方面，Ryzen 7 9850X3D 基于 AMD Zen 5 架构，维持 8 核 16 线程和 4.2 GHz 基础频率，但加速频率提升至 5.6 GHz。缓存总量仍为 104MB，其中 96MB 为 3D V-Cache。3D V-Cache 通过堆叠大容量 L3 缓存，显著降低游戏中的内存访问延迟，是其游戏性能领先的关键。默认 TDP 为 120W，但实测峰值功耗约 170W。平台方面，它沿用 AM5 接口，支持 DDR5 内存，并兼容现有 600 系和 800 系 AMD 主板。

性能测试显示，Ryzen 7 9850X3D 仅比 9800X3D 快约 3.3%，但在 16 款游戏的 1080p FPS 几何平均测试中排名第一，超过价格更高的 Ryzen 9 9900X3D 和 9950X3D。虽然在部分生产力负载中不敌 Intel，但其单 CCD、8 核结构带来更低功耗和更好散热表现。搭配赠送的 240mm AIO 水冷，游戏和中等负载下温度可控，重度多核负载下可能偏热。

总体来看，这次促销价低于首发价，还附带实用水冷和游戏，适合计划组装或升级高端游戏 PC 的玩家。AM5 平台兼容性广，加上 3D V-Cache 带来的高帧率优势，使其对追求 1080p 高刷新率游戏体验的用户尤其有吸引力。

history.title: Bernie Sanders proposes 20 year prison sentence for AI devs who plow ahead with Artificial Superintelligence plans — penalty on par with illegally developing rogue nuclear weapons
history.description: Senators Bernie Sanders and Greg Cezar have announced their Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act which threatens 20-year prison sentences for rule breakers.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 14 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Senators Bernie Sanders and Greg Cezar have announced their Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act. Seeking to pause advanced AI development, the legislation’s stick is pretty severe. Penalties facing entities/developers who violate the pauses and prohibitions in the bill could face up to 20 years in prison. That’s a sentence on a par with someone found guilty of designing a rogue nuclear weapon. (Image credit: Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act)The news is suddenly filled with grave concerns about AI becoming too powerful. It could even threaten the future of humanity. Moreover, it might surprise casual observers that AI industry leaders like Sam Altman, Dario Amodei, and Elon Musk appear to agree. With this threat on the horizon, politicians are keen to introduce legislation to protect the citizens they serve.According to USA Today, the Sanders bill “is the most extreme AI-related legislation to date.” It likely faces strong opposition in Congress, particularly among enterprise-supporting Democrats and Trump-aligned Republicans. However, with recent statements from industry leaders seemingly harmonizing with calls to slow down AI development and in favor of greater oversight/regulation, we could see politicians agree on something for a change.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Back to the Ban Artificial Superintelligence and Temporarily Pause Advanced AI Development bill and its specific wording, we note that it is advised that the government set up a new cabinet-level federal agency "to safeguard the public from the dangers of artificial intelligence, including by enforcing a prohibition on artificial superintelligence." As well as setting harsh penalties in the U.S., it is proposed that work be done to "ban superintelligence around the world" via international agreements, allied coordination, and so on.Full speed ahead, or hit the brakes?There remain plenty of interesting arguments on both sides of the AI progress divide. It is difficult to argue that the U.S. shouldn’t keep going as fast as it can, as a matter of national security, for example. On the other hand, the whole of humanity being wiped from the face of the Earth by opening Pandora’s AI box of tricks makes geopolitical concerns seem like minor grumbles. Some critics say they may be running out of road, unable to balance private investments with credible paths to profitability. Thus, they now want to move away from a commercially funded model to a government-funded ‘Manhattan Project II,’ with their terrifyingly powerful AI being guarded by the state. history.titleZh: Bernie Sanders proposes 20 year prison sentence for AI devs who plow ahead with Artificial Superintelligence plans — penalty on par with illegally developing rogue nuclear weapons
history.descriptionZh:
美国参议员伯尼·桑德斯与格雷格·塞扎尔宣布提出《禁止人工超级智能法案》（Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act），其完整目标还包括“暂时暂停高级人工智能发展”。该法案试图暂停先进 AI 开发，并设置了极为严厉的惩罚：违反法案中暂停与禁止条款的实体或开发者，最高可面临 20 年监禁。这一刑期被类比为与设计失控核武器同级。据 USA Today 报道，这是迄今为止“最极端的 AI 相关立法”。法案预计将在国会遭遇强烈反对，尤其是来自支持企业界的民主党人和与特朗普阵营一致的共和党人；但近期 AI 行业领袖的表态似乎与“放缓 AI 发展、加强监管”的呼吁趋同，因此也可能出现政界罕见达成共识的情况。

法案的具体机制包括：建议政府设立一个新的内阁级联邦机构，负责“保护公众免受人工智能危险”，包括执行对人工超级智能的禁令。除在美国国内实施严厉处罚外，法案还提议通过国际协议、盟友协调等方式，推动“在全球范围内禁止超级智能”。这里所谓“人工超级智能”，通常指在几乎所有认知任务上远超人类水平的人工智能系统。因此，该法案并非针对现有窄域 AI 或普通大模型，而是试图从法律和制度层面阻止超级智能的出现。原文没有披露具体模型架构、训练方法、算力规模或性能基准数据；其“对比数据”主要体现在法律处罚力度上：20 年监禁与设计 rogue nuclear weapon 相当。该法案的创新点也不在技术突破，而在政策工具组合：刑事重罚、内阁级监管机构、国际协调与全球禁令。

新闻背景是近期关于 AI 变得过于强大、甚至威胁人类未来的担忧骤然升温。令人注意的是，Sam Altman、Dario Amodei、Elon Musk 等 AI 行业领袖似乎也认同这类风险。争论的核心是“全速前进还是踩刹车”：一方认为，从国家安全角度，美国不可能也不应放慢 AI 发展；另一方则认为，如果打开 AI 潘多拉魔盒导致人类被从地球上抹去，那么地缘政治担忧都只是小问题。相关立法动向还包括：桑德斯另提法案建议美国 AI 公司 50% 公有制并向公众发放 1,000 美元股息；两党法案提议为最强 AI 模型设置“kill switches”；Anthropic CEO 警告 AI 驱动的 botnet“swarm”可能接管整个互联网。对于 AI 巨头突然支持监管，批评者提出另一种解释：它们可能已快走到商业模式的尽头，难以平衡私人投资与可信盈利路径，因此希望从商业资助模式转向政府资助的“曼哈顿计划 II”，由国家对强大 AI 进行守护。

若该法案推进，将深刻影响美国 AI 研发合规、投资策略、开源与闭源路线、全球竞争和地缘政治。其应用场景主要包括联邦监管执法、AI 公司合规审查、国际协议谈判、盟友协调以及国家安全风险管控。不过，鉴于国会阻力，该法案通过前景很低。总体而言，这则新闻反映 AI 安全辩论已从技术伦理讨论进入刑事立法和全球禁令的极端政策层面。

history.title: Intel revives One Mono font after brief retirement during open-source purge — typeface built to fight coder eyestrain gets reprieve
history.description: Intel’s decision to archive its developer-focused One Mono font lasted only two days, with the company now restoring the open-source project despite its relatively limited development activity.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Intel has reversed its decision to shelve its open-source font project designed specifically with developers in mind. The font’s GitHub repository was archived earlier this week, only for the company to reportedly restore the project and potentially continue to maintain it. The cancellation came amid a wider reduction in Intel’s open-source efforts. According to Phoronix, Intel has been closing down projects where development has slowed, or the employees responsible for them have exited the company.Introduced back in 2023, One Mono is a monospace font where each character occupies the same horizontal width. Intel carried out the development in collaboration with type design studio Frere-Jones Type and marketing agency VMLY&R. Working with low-vision and legally blind developers during the design process, live testing sessions were conducted to identify characters that could be difficult to distinguish when reading code.“Identifying the typographically underserved low-vision developer audience, we designed the Intel One Mono typeface for maximum legibility to address developers' fatigue and eyestrain and reduce coding errors,” said Intel in its introduction.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: The font was designed with several features to improve legibility, including distinctions between similar-looking letters and coding characters. For example, characters such as the lowercase “e” and uppercase “G” were given more distinctive shapes to make them easier to identify. The difference in height between uppercase and lowercase letters was also increased, along with longer ascenders and descenders to make blocks of code easier to read. Additionally, the font supports more than 200 languages using the Latin script and is available in Light, Regular, Medium, and Bold weights, along with matching italics.As mentioned, One Mono is available under an open-source license; thus, developers are free to use and modify it. Unfortunately, the font has not witnessed any significant updates since 2024, with activity during 2025 reportedly limited to Readme updates. Thus, its archival seemed pretty obvious, especially with Intel shutting down projects that were no longer seeing active development. For now, the font has managed to avoid becoming a casualty of Intel’s open-source cleanup. While the project remains silent, its revival means the developer-focused font is not being abandoned after all. history.titleZh: 英特尔在开源清理中短暂退役后重启One Mono字体——这款为对抗程序员眼疲劳而打造的字体获得缓刑
history.descriptionZh:
Intel 近日逆转了此前搁置其专为开发者设计的开源字体项目 One Mono 的决定。该字体的 GitHub 仓库曾于本周早些时候被归档，但随后公司据报恢复了项目，并可能继续维护。这一反复发生在 Intel 更广泛收缩开源投入的背景下。据 Phoronix 报道，Intel 正在关闭那些开发进度放缓、或负责员工已经离职的项目，因此 One Mono 最初被归档并不令人意外。

One Mono 于 2023 年推出，是一款等宽字体，即每个字符占据相同的水平宽度，这使其特别适合代码编辑器和终端等编程场景。Intel 与字体设计工作室 Frere-Jones Type 以及营销机构 VMLY&R 合作开发了这款字体。设计过程中，团队与低视力及法定盲人开发者合作，并通过现场测试来识别阅读代码时容易混淆的字符。Intel 在介绍中表示：“我们识别出排版领域服务不足的低视力开发者群体，设计了 Intel One Mono 字体，以最大化可读性，缓解开发者的疲劳和眼疲劳，并减少编码错误。”

在技术细节上，One Mono 针对可读性做了多项优化。例如，小写“e”和大写“G”等字符被赋予更独特的形状，以便更容易区分；大写和小写字母之间的高度差被加大，同时上升部和下降部也被延长，从而使整块代码更易于阅读。该字体支持 200 多种使用拉丁字母的语言，并提供 Light、Regular、Medium、Bold 四种字重以及匹配的斜体。作为开源字体，开发者可以自由使用和修改它。

从应用场景看，One Mono 主要面向需要长时间阅读和编写代码的开发者，尤其是低视力用户。它试图在等宽字体这一细分领域中，通过包容性设计提升编程体验，减少因字符混淆而导致的错误。不过，该字体自 2024 年以来没有重大更新，2025 年的活动据报仅限于 Readme 更新，因此其归档曾显得顺理成章。目前，One Mono 已避免成为 Intel 开源清理的牺牲品。尽管项目仍保持沉默，但此次复活意味着这款面向开发者的字体并未被彻底放弃。其未来维护频率和更新计划仍有待观察，但至少短期内它不会从开源社区消失。

history.title: Chinese military researchers and tech giants caught using Claude — US frontier model coded 16 air-defense suppression tools targeting Taiwan, drafted anti-torpedo specs, and fed 151 million training queries to Alibaba
history.description: Anthropic accuses China-linked actors of using its Claude models of weapon development, intelligence activities, distilling AI models.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter While China claims to have advanced AI models that may well compete against those developed in the U.S., for some reason, hundreds of China-linked agents allegedly used Anthropic for at least five different programs: two military, two surveillance, and one aimed at distilling Claude's capabilities, according to Anthropic's September 2026 threat report.Two military programsOne China-based actor used Claude to draft a fire-control specification for an anti-torpedo fire-control system (the core logic that determines when and where an anti-torpedo weapon should engage an incoming threat), test the potential system against U.S. Navy anti-torpedo and anti-submarine systems based on public knowledge about these programs, and prep a 200+ page technical proposal for a potential client. While the actor disguised itself as an OEM in the U.S. defense sector, Anthropic believes that the actor was associated with a Chinese defense manufacturer seeking to develop a system for the People's Liberation Army Navy.Another China-based defense and military-industrial researcher used Claude to develop about 16 software modules for electronic warfare and suppression of enemy air defenses. The software analyzed radars, SAM sites, command posts, and communications nodes and prioritized targets. At one point, the default scenario contained 12 targets in Taiwan, including Patriot and Tien Kung batteries, air bases, an early-warning radar, and a command bunker. Interestingly, Anthropic claims that account metadata and content caught by its safeguards 'indicated the actor was linked to PRC research institutions, including the PLA Academy of Military Sciences,' though it does not outright say that Claude was used by the PLA.Given China's considerable AI capabilities — which may still lag behind those of the United States in some areas (more on this later) — it is striking that two Chinese military-related projects relied on Anthropic's Claude. Given the Chinese-language prompts and other account-level evidence identified by Anthropic, plausible deniability hardly seems to have been the primary reason for choosing Claude over domestic alternatives. More likely, Claude was simply better or more convenient for these particular engineering workflows, particularly coding, reasoning, and agentic tasks. There may also have been another advantage: U.S. frontier models are trained on enormous amounts of English-language material and could therefore have particularly extensive knowledge of publicly available information about American military technologies and systems.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Given China's major AI prowess (which may well fall short of American, but still be quite capable), it is interesting to see two Chinese military projects using Anthropic AI. Given Chinese IP addresses and Chinese language prompts detected by Anthropic, plausible deniability is certainly not the main reason for using Claude instead of using domestic tools (more on this later). Apparently, Claude was better or more convenient for these particular engineering workflows (coding => reasoning => agentic) than whatever models the actors could readily access. Furthermore, after all, U.S. frontier models were trained mostly on English-language materials, and they may have way more information about American military capability than Chinese spy channels have ever gotten (we are speculating, of course).Significant surveillance activitiesAnthropic also disrupted China-linked surveillance operations related to Uyghurs outside of China, perhaps because similar operations are already in place in the Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region. One China government-linked actor used Claude to infiltrate Uyghur armed groups in Syria and surveil Uyghur diaspora activists and media, while posing as an Arabic-speaking 'expert' consultant. You may like Anthropic claims that China's Alibaba illicitly 'distilled' its models from April to June 2026 Alibaba bans Anthropic's Claude Code after an alleged hidden China-detection backdoor is uncovered China alleges that Claude Code contains backdoors, calls mechanism 'a serious threat' Once the agent had infiltrated the said groups, Claude helped process information collected from more than a hundred WhatsApp groups and dozens of Telegram channels, identify people across platforms, map social networks, and reveal potential recruitment targets considered vulnerable because of financial problems, family separation, or ideological disillusionment with the new Syrian government.The actor also singled out individuals with relatives remaining in Xinjiang, while Claude helped draft deceptive approaches in local dialects, locate people and organizations, translate conversations in real time, and evaluate the credibility of recruitment messages. The same operation targeted diaspora journalists, particularly Uyghur Post, with coordinated mass-reporting and bot-amplification campaigns.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsStealing from AnthropicPerhaps the most ironic thing about Anthropic's findings is that Chinese entities steal from the company. While reported broadly in 2024 – 2025, it does not stop Chinese entities from using distillation, the main way to 'steal' an AI model's capabilities without obtaining the model itself.Anthropic says several major Chinese AI developers conducted industrial-scale distillation campaigns designed to extract Claude's reasoning and other capabilities and reproduce them in their own models. The largest one allegedly came from Alibaba, whose operators generated more than 151 million Claude exchanges between May and July 2026. At one point, this approached 3 million requests per day through thousands of fraudulent accounts. Anthropic says the harvested chain-of-thought data helped train Qwen 3.x, particularly for reasoning, coding, agentic software engineering, kernel development, and long-horizon tasks, according to Anthropic.Alibaba is far from alone, as Anthropic accuses DeepSeek, Xiaomi, Zhipu/Z.ai, and others of similar campaigns. Techniques they have allegedly used span from proxy networks and fraudulent accounts to disguising the secret entity all the way to forwarding their own customers' requests to Claude and purchasing harvested Claude conversations from third parties. DeepSeek alone allegedly generated more than 12.1 million exchanges in 14 days, while Xiaomi generated more than 400,000.Anthropic defines this activity as distillation: covertly extracting a frontier model's answers and then replicating the knowledge at a fraction of the compute, time, and cost required to develop them in-house. history.titleZh: 中国军事研究人员和科技巨头被抓使用Claude——美国前沿模型编写了16种针对台湾的防空压制工具，起草了反鱼雷规格，并向阿里巴巴提供了1.51亿次训练查询
history.descriptionZh:
Anthropic 2026年9月威胁报告披露，尽管中国宣称已拥有可与美国竞争的前沿AI模型，但据称有数百个与中国有关联的行为体使用Anthropic的Claude，至少涉及五类项目：两个军事项目、两个监控项目，以及一个旨在蒸馏Claude能力的项目。报告的核心含义是，美国前沿模型在部分工程、情报和模型训练场景中，仍被中国相关行为体视为高价值工具；即便存在中国本土替代品，Claude在编码、推理和智能体任务上可能更好用或更便捷。

两个军事项目尤其引人关注。第一个项目中，一个中国行为体使用Claude起草反鱼雷火控系统规格。火控系统的核心逻辑决定反鱼雷武器应在何时、何地拦截来袭威胁。该行为体还基于公开知识，用Claude测试潜在系统对抗美国海军反鱼雷和反潜系统的能力，并准备了一份200多页的技术建议书，面向潜在客户。该行为体伪装成美国国防部门原始设备制造商，但Anthropic认为其实际与中国一家国防制造商有关，目标是为中国人民解放军海军开发系统。第二个项目中，一名中国国防与军工研究员使用Claude开发了约16个电子战和压制敌方防空（SEAD）软件模块。这些软件用于分析雷达、地空导弹阵地、指挥所和通信节点，并对目标进行优先级排序。报告称，其默认场景包含台湾的12个目标，包括爱国者与天弓防空导弹阵地、空军基地、预警雷达和指挥掩体。Anthropic表示，账户元数据和内容显示该行为体与中华人民共和国研究机构有关，包括解放军军事科学院，但并未直接断言Claude被解放军使用。

报告特别指出，考虑到中国自身AI能力并不弱，两个与中国军方相关的项目依赖Claude，说明“合理推诿”并非选择Claude的主要原因。更可能的解释是，Claude在这些特定工程流程中表现更好或更便于使用，尤其是编码、推理和智能体任务。另一个潜在优势是，美国前沿模型主要用海量英文材料训练，可能对公开可得的美国军事技术和系统信息掌握更广。换言之，Claude不仅可能在某些能力上领先，还可能因英文语料优势而更了解美国军事体系。

监控活动方面，Anthropic还中断了与中国有关联、针对境外维吾尔人的监控行动。报告推测，这可能与新疆地区已有类似行动有关。一个与中国政府有关联的行为体冒充阿拉伯语“专家”顾问，使用Claude渗透叙利亚的维吾尔武装团体，并监控维吾尔侨民活动人士和媒体。渗透后，Claude帮助处理来自100多个WhatsApp群组和数十个Telegram频道的信息，跨平台识别人员、绘制社交网络，并找出潜在招募目标。报告称，这些目标被认为因经济困难、家庭分离或对新叙利亚政府意识形态幻灭而较为脆弱。该行为体还专门挑出有亲属留在新疆的人，并利用Claude起草当地方言的欺骗性接触话术、定位人员和组织、实时翻译对话，以及评估招募信息的可信度。同一行动还针对侨民记者，尤其是《维吾尔邮报》，通过协调大规模举报和机器人放大运动进行攻击。

最具讽刺意味的部分是模型蒸馏。Anthropic称，多家中国主要AI开发商进行了工业规模的蒸馏活动，试图提取Claude的推理等能力并复制到自家模型中。其中最大规模据称来自阿里巴巴：2026年5月至7月，其操作者生成了超过1.51亿次Claude交互，某时每天接近300万次请求，并通过数千个欺诈账户实施。Anthropic称，收集到的思维链数据帮助训练了Qwen 3.x，尤其在推理、编码、智能体软件工程、内核开发和长时程任务方面。阿里巴巴并非个例，Anthropic还指控DeepSeek、小米、智谱/Z.ai等存在类似活动。其所谓手段包括代理网络、欺诈账户、伪装秘密实体、把自家客户请求转发给Claude，以及从第三方购买已收集的Claude对话。DeepSeek据称在14天内生成超过1210万次交互，小米则超过40万次。Anthropic将蒸馏定义为：秘密提取前沿模型的答案，然后以远低于内部开发的算力、时间和成本复制相关知识。

总体来看，这份报告描绘了前沿AI模型被滥用于军事工程、电子战、跨境监控、社会网络情报和模型能力窃取的完整链条。其技术影响在于，AI模型可显著降低复杂军事软件、目标分析和情报处理的门槛；同时，模型蒸馏使开发商能在不获取权重的情况下，以大量API交互和思维链数据快速逼近前沿能力。对Anthropic等前沿模型厂商而言，这意味着滥用检测、账户安全、代理网络识别和蒸馏防御将成为持续挑战；对政策层面而言，则涉及AI出口管制、模型安全、地缘政治竞争以及开源与闭源模型生态的治理问题。

history.title: Mexican cartel's crypto farm seized in mountain raid — 300 GPUs, satellite links, and industrial transformers tapped hydroelectric power
history.description: There is increasing evidence that Mexican drug cartels are diversifying into cryptocurrency mining and are using crypto platforms to launder their ill-gotten gains.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 2 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter There is increasing evidence that Mexican drug cartels are diversifying into cryptocurrency mining and are using crypto platforms to diversify their income and, at the same time, launder their ill-gotten gains and fund other illegal activities. Reuters reports that local Mexican police uncovered a clandestine cryptocurrency farm in Tlaola, a town located in the leafy mountains of Puebla's Sierra Norte region. They found 300 GPUs, electricity infrastructure, and satellite equipment. The electricity-hungry operation likely drew power by secretly tapping into the grid at Presa de Necaxa, a nearby hydroelectric dam.Go deeper with TH Premium: AI shortages (Image credit: Nvidia)AI data centers are swallowing the world's memory and storage supplyDemand for data center CPUs has surged, and AI agents are responsibleChip scarcity assaults auto industry amid the worsening Nexperia and DRAM crisisThe custom AI ASIC state of playWhile this latest hidden facility found by police may seem small, Reuters notes it is the fourth such crypto farm Mexican authorities have uncovered in this region since early last year. According to a Mexico-based security analyst, the crypto farms discovered show that the cartels are increasingly sophisticated in their operations. In the latest bust, the Mexican federal authorities, the Navy, and state police seized around 300 GPUs, 80 medium-voltage terminations, a transformer, and eight satellite antennas.It might not be surprising to hear about the Mexican cartels being tied up in crypto. Blockchain analytics firm Chainalysis, as cited by Reuters, reckons illicit crypto transactions grew from $59 billion in 2024 to $154 billion last year. The firm links the surge recorded to sanctions evasion involving governments. However, in South America, cartels are increasingly interested in using this channel to launder money. The mining operations are also integrated into the scheme, as stealing electricity is easy for organized crime. Mainstream consumer GPU mining ended in H2 2022, flooding the market with used graphics cards.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: The source report doesn’t say how authorities found the crypto farm. Perhaps locals in this remote area of Puebla alerted authorities to the operation. Two folks from neighboring communities told Reuters that they could hear the crypto farm noise (transformers, cooling) from a kilometer away (0.6 miles), and the place was apparently a mere 2 km (1.2 miles) from the nearest village. The other three recently uncovered crypto farms were also near the same HEP dam, it is noted. Tlaola is a small community with around 20,000 inhabitants, so the noise levels and power consumption of crypto farms are very perceptible even if the cartels try to hide them deep in the mountains.Remote communities, such as Tlaola, are popular locations for clandestine crypto farms because the electricity is cheap and most of them are under the protection of the cartels. For example, the Cartel Jalisco Nueva Generación (CJNG) and its armed branch, La Barredora, have the strongest presence in Puebla. Drug cartels such as the Cartel de Sinaloa and the CJNG have set up crypto farms to mine Bitcoin (BTC), Monero (XMR), and Tether (USDT).Similarly remote, illicit cryptomining facilities exist around the world, with Reuters recalling news of raids in Brazil, the U.S., and Thailand. history.titleZh: Mexican cartel's crypto farm seized in mountain raid — 300 GPUs, satellite links, and industrial transformers tapped hydroelectric power
history.descriptionZh:
路透社报道称，墨西哥贩毒集团正越来越多地涉足加密货币挖矿，并利用加密平台实现收入多元化、洗钱以及资助其他非法活动。墨西哥警方在普埃布拉州北部山区小镇特拉奥拉发现了一座秘密加密货币矿场，现场有约300块GPU、电力基础设施和卫星设备。该矿场耗电巨大，很可能通过秘密接入附近普雷萨德内卡哈水电站的电网来偷电。这已是墨西哥当局自去年初以来在同一地区发现的第四座此类加密货币矿场，显示出贩毒集团相关操作的复杂程度正在上升。

在最新一次突袭中，墨西哥联邦当局、海军和州警察缴获了约300块GPU、80个中压终端设备、一台变压器和八根卫星天线。从技术原理看，加密货币挖矿依赖大量GPU并行执行哈希运算，以争夺区块链记账权并获得代币奖励。这种过程耗电量极高、发热量大、噪音明显，还需要持续的网络连接和冷却系统。卫星天线可能用于在偏远山区建立网络连接或规避地面通信监控，而偷电则显著降低了矿场的运营成本。犯罪组织正是利用偏远地区电价低廉、执法薄弱且受卡特尔势力保护的条件，把非法电力转化为可交易的加密资产。

目前尚不清楚当局是如何发现这座矿场的。路透社称，附近社区居民表示，他们能在约1公里外听到矿场变压器和冷却设备产生的噪音，而该矿场距离最近的村庄仅约2公里。特拉奥拉约有2万居民，因此矿场的噪音和电力消耗即便被藏匿在深山中也很难完全不被察觉。此前发现的三座矿场也位于同一座水电站附近。这类偏远社区之所以成为秘密矿场热门地点，是因为电力便宜，且许多地区处于贩毒集团控制之下。例如，哈利斯科新一代卡特尔及其武装分支“拉巴雷多拉”在普埃布拉势力最强。

加密货币与墨西哥贩毒集团的关联并不令人意外。区块链分析公司Chainalysis的数据显示，非法加密货币交易规模从2024年的590亿美元增至上年的1540亿美元，这一激增与政府制裁规避行为有关；而在南美，卡特尔越来越倾向于利用加密渠道洗钱。墨西哥网络安全公司SILIKN指出，去年墨西哥利用加密货币挖矿洗钱的活动至少增长了55.8%。锡那罗亚卡特尔和哈利斯科新一代卡特尔等组织已建立矿场，用于挖掘比特币、门罗币和泰达币。值得注意的是，主流消费者GPU挖矿已在2022年下半年结束，导致大量二手显卡涌入市场。

类似偏远地区的非法加密货币挖矿设施并非墨西哥独有。路透社提到，巴西、美国和泰国也曾有相关突袭行动。分析人士预计，未来几年与加密货币相关的犯罪可能达到新高度。此类案件的技术影响在于，它把能源盗窃、加密资产、洗钱和有组织犯罪结合在一起：一方面给偏远地区电网和社区生活带来负担，另一方面也增加了金融取证难度。虽然区块链分析工具可以追踪部分非法交易，但门罗币等隐私币、稳定币以及场外交易渠道仍会加大执法挑战，需要能源、网络和金融监管部门协同应对。

history.title: Build a high-end AMD gaming PC for less — Ryzen 7 9800X3D bundle includes an X870E motherboard, 32GB DDR5, AIO cooler and a game for $1,109.99
history.description: The bundle pairs one of the best gaming CPUs available with a premium X870E motherboard and 32GB of DDR5-6000 memory, while also throwing in a 240mm AIO cooler and a free copy of Onimusha: Way of the Sword.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter With the ongoing memory crisis driving up the price of RAM and other components, it is arguably one of the worst times to build a new gaming PC. However, bundle deals can be a good way to offset some of those inflated prices. Speaking of which, we’ve spotted an incredible AMD bundle over at Newegg that includes the AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D, an Asus TUF X870E motherboard, and 32GB of Corsair Vengeance RGB DDR5-6000 RAM for $1,109.99, offering savings of around $150. The bundle also includes a 240mm Cooler Master AIO liquid cooler and a copy of Onimusha: Way of the Sword as free gifts. Check out the deal in Newegg The Ryzen 7 9800X3D is an 8-core, 16-thread processor based on AMD’s Zen 5 architecture. With a 4.7 GHz base clock and up to 5.2 GHz boost clock, the highlight feature of the chip is its 3D V-Cache technology that helps in lowering latency and giving a boost in overall gaming performance. If you’re looking for the best gaming CPU for a high-end build, the Ryzen 7 9800X3D should be at the top of your list. AMD TUF GAMING X870E-PLUS WIFI7 ATX Motherboard, 16+2+1 80A Power Stages, DDR5, PCIe 5.0, Four M.2 Slots, WiFi 7, AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D 8-Core 5.2 GHz, CORSAIR Vengeance RGB 32GB DDR5 6000 RAM: was $1,258.98 now $1,109.99 at NeweggNewegg’s bundle brings together AMD’s Ryzen 7 9800X3D, an Asus X870E motherboard, 32GB of DDR5 memory and a free 240mm AIO cooler, making it a compelling option for a high-end gaming build.View Deal The Asus TUF Gaming X870E-Plus motherboard should be a suitable pairing for the 9800X3D as it offers premium features including a robust power delivery system, dual PCIe 5.0 M.2 SSD storage slots, and solid connectivity. The motherboard supports Wi-Fi 7, 2.5Gb Ethernet, dual USB4 (40Gbps) Type-C ports, and front USB 20Gbps Type-C connector with up to 30W PD Fast-charge. It also offers enlarged heatsinks for the VRM, M.2 storage and PCH, as well as tools to overclock and fine tune various features.Last but not least, the bundle includes a Corsair Vengeance RGB kit with two 16GB DDR5 modules running at 6000 MT/s, with a CAS latency of CL36 and timings of 44-44-96. The memory features black aluminum heat spreaders with a patterned finish, along with RGB lighting across the top of each module. It also supports both Intel XMP and AMD EXPO profiles, making it easy to apply pre-configured memory overclocking settings.If we look at individual pricing, Ryzen 7 9800X3D is currently $469, while the Corsair RAM kit and Asus motherboard are listed at $499.99 and $289.99, respectively. You also get a CPU liquid cooler worth $79.99 and a copy of Onimusha: Way of the Sword worth $69.99. That puts the combined value at around $1,408.96, making the $1,109.99 bundle price a saving of nearly $300. If you're planning a high-end AMD gaming PC, this bundle is definitely worth exploring.

history.titleZh: Build a high-end AMD gaming PC for less — Ryzen 7 9800X3D bundle includes an X870E motherboard, 32GB DDR5, AIO cooler and a game for $1,109.99
history.descriptionZh:
当前内存危机持续推高RAM等核心部件价格，DIY游戏PC的装机成本明显上升。在此背景下，Newegg推出的一款AMD平台捆绑套装成为对冲涨价的选项。该套装售价1109.99美元，包含AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D处理器、华硕TUF Gaming X870E-Plus WiFi7 ATX主板、32GB Corsair Vengeance RGB DDR5-6000内存，并附赠240mm Cooler Master AIO液冷散热器和《Onimusha: Way of the Sword》游戏。若按单独售价计算，CPU约469美元、内存约499.99美元、主板约289.99美元，加上散热器和游戏分别价值约79.99美元和69.99美元，合计约1408.96美元，因此套装可节省近300美元；若仅按Newegg标注的套装原价1258.98美元对比，则节省约150美元。

核心技术方面，Ryzen 7 9800X3D基于Zen 5架构，为8核16线程，基础频率4.7GHz，加速频率最高5.2GHz。其最大特色是3D V-Cache技术，通过在处理器上堆叠额外L3缓存，显著增加可用缓存容量，降低游戏等负载的内存访问延迟，从而提升帧率和游戏响应。该处理器被认为是高端游戏主机的首选CPU之一。华硕TUF Gaming X870E-Plus主板提供16+2+1相80A供电、DDR5内存支持、PCIe 5.0、四个M.2插槽，支持Wi-Fi 7、2.5Gb以太网、双USB4 40Gbps Type-C以及前置USB 20Gbps Type-C 30W PD快充，并配有加大VRM、M.2和PCH散热片，便于超频和精细调校。内存为两条16GB DDR5-6000，CL36，时序44-44-96，带黑色铝制散热片和RGB灯效，支持Intel XMP与AMD EXPO一键超频。

总体来看，该套装把当前价格较高的内存、主板和热门游戏CPU打包，适合计划组建高端AMD游戏PC的用户。X870E平台提供PCIe 5.0存储、USB4和Wi-Fi 7等扩展能力，能在未来一段时间内保持较好兼容性；而3D V-Cache则直接利好游戏性能。在内存价格高企时，这类捆绑可降低整机采购总成本，是需要升级或新装高端游戏平台时值得关注的方案。
